department: Department of Brain and Cognitive Sciences

deadline.value: Applications for Fall 2027 close December 1, 2026; later or incomplete ones may not be considered.
deadline.quote: The closing date for applications for admission in Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026.

app_fee.quote: The application fee is $30 and is non-refundable.

gre_general.quote: GRE is not required. | GRE exam scores, verbal, quantitative, and analytical writing sections, are optional to all applicants to our graduate program.

gre_subject.value: An advanced (subject) test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: An advanced test in a field of specialization is not required.

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: All admitted students get a fellowship with stipend, tuition and health insurance, guaranteed for five years subject to progress.
funding.quote: All students admitted to the program are offered graduate fellowships that provide a competitive 12-month stipend, cover the costs of tuition, health insurance, and other fees. Support is guaranteed for five years subject to satisfactory academic progress.

entry_route.value: The admissions page does not state whether a master's is needed.

notes: The School of Medicine and Dentistry also runs a separate Neuroscience PhD with its own application (fee $60, December 1 deadline); see the biomed record for its rules.
